blind.description: A standalone section of a stylized wooden picket fence. It features nine vertical pale wooden pickets with pointed tops, attached to horizontal crossbars with visible dark circular nails or bolt heads. The wood has a painted texture with warmer brown highlights along the pointed tops and edges. Surfaces are solid, smooth, and fully intact, sitting directly on the ground without an extra base.
blind.from_above: A narrow straight strip composed of small alternating rectangular picket caps connected along a central rail, casting a serrated saw-tooth shadow to the left.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2.5 to 3 feet tall (reaching roughly hip height of the 5 ft 9 in figure) and about 4.5 to 5 feet wide.
